AdminUnlockDialog.title: Administrator sign-in
AdminUnlockDialog.hint: Enter the administrator password to open the full interface.
AdminUnlockDialog.createHint: No password has been set yet. At least {{n}} characters.
AdminUnlockDialog.createNote: Remember it: without the password the full interface cannot be opened. Support can reset it.
AdminUnlockDialog.lockedOut: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
AdminUnlockDialog.tooShort: The password must be at least {{n}} characters long.
AdminUnlockDialog.storageError: The password could not be saved to disk.

OperatorAbout.supportHint: If something does not work, contact the supplier:

OperatorStatusBar.uptimeTip: Time since the vehicle was switched on
OperatorStatusBar.tiltTip: Amber from {{warn}}°, red from {{limit}}°: the vehicle may tip over
OperatorStatusBar.hdopTip: GPS accuracy: the lower the better (under 2 is good)
OperatorStatusBar.heading: Heading
OperatorStatusBar.recordWaitingTip: Recording is on. No camera is sending video right now; the recording starts by itself as soon as one does.

OperatorCameras.noCameras: No cameras are set up. Ask the administrator to add them.
OperatorCameras.allPoppedOut: Every camera is open in a window of its own. Close one of those windows to bring it back here.
OperatorCameras.cameraGone: This camera is no longer set up.
OperatorCameras.dragTip: Drag to move; pull the corner to resize
OperatorCameras.popOut: Open in a separate window (for another monitor)

OperatorScreen.stopTip: Stops the vehicle at once (Hold mode); the Space key does the same. Pressed again, the button lets the vehicle go on.
OperatorScreen.holdTip: Hold until the bar fills: ARM / DISARM
OperatorScreen.commandNotSent: The command could not be sent: there is no link to the vehicle.
OperatorScreen.modeRefused: The vehicle did not switch to "{{mode}}".
OperatorScreen.notRover: This vehicle is not a ground vehicle: STOP and mode buttons are off.
OperatorScreen.layoutGridTip: Show all cameras side by side
OperatorScreen.layoutPipTip: One camera full size, the others as thumbnails
OperatorScreen.pinControlsTip: Keep day/night, light and HD/SD on screen. Otherwise they show when the pointer is over the video.
OperatorScreen.resetArrangementTip: Put the windows back where they started
OperatorScreen.resumeTip: The vehicle is stopped (Hold). Press to return to the mode it was driven in; take joystick control again if you were driving from it.
OperatorScreen.resumeRefused: The vehicle did not leave Hold

OperatorShell.linkNotSetTip: The administrator sets the connection in the full interface
OperatorShell.disconnectTip: Drop the link to the vehicle. It will not reconnect until you press Connect.
OperatorShell.toOperatorModeTip: Close the full interface and return to the operator screen

OperatorWorkspaceSettings.title: Operator workspace
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.intro: The program opens on the operator screen: cameras, vehicle state and a few actions. Here, tab by tab, is what the operator sees and may do. Cameras are set up on the «Video» tab, with or without a link to the vehicle.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.startInOperatorMode: Open the app in operator mode
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.startInOperatorModeHint: Switch off only on a service or development computer: the app then opens straight into the full interface, without a password.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.autoLock: Return to operator mode after inactivity of
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.connectionHint: The operator has no connection panel. The screen connects by itself to the link chosen here.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.connectionLast: Not fixed: the last used link is taken ({{link}}).
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.connectionNone: Not fixed, and nothing has been connected on this computer yet.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.pinConnectionNone: Connect once in the full interface first
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.autoConnectHint: On start-up and after a lost link, retrying every few seconds.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.actionsHint: STOP (Hold mode, also the Space key) is always on the screen.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.allowArmHint: Always by holding the button, never by a single click.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.tiltHint: Roll and pitch in the status strip turn amber, then red.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.videoHint: Recordings are saved on this computer. A camera with no picture is waited for: recording starts by itself when video appears and resumes after every dropout.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.recordAll: Record every camera, not just the main one
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.supportHint: Shown to the operator on the «About» page. Empty lines are not shown. A Telegram name like @name and the site become links.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.passwordHint: Opens the full interface from the operator's About page. At least {{n}} characters. Kept only as a hash.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.passwordReset: A forgotten password is reset by support: the file "operator-admin.json" is removed from the app data folder, after which a new password can be created.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.statusFieldsHint: The telemetry values across the top of the operator screen, in this order. Armed state and the recording indicator are always there.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.noFields: No values selected: the strip shows the armed state only.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.elementsHint: Parts of the operator screen besides the panel. STOP is always there; the panel's own controls are set under «Control panel».
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.element_popOut: Opening a camera or the map in a separate window
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.modesHint: The modes the operator can switch to. Up to three show as buttons; more fold into a «Mode» list. STOP (Hold) is always there.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.recordModeHint_always: From the moment the operator screen opens, with or without video and with or without a link to the vehicle.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.recordModeHint_armed: Starts on ARM, stops on DISARM.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.recordModeHint_manual: A «Record» button appears on the operator screen.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.recordDirDefault: The default folder: «STOHID» in this computer's Videos.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.recordDirFree: Free: {{free}}. Recording stops when less than 1 GB is left.
OperatorWorkspaceSettings.camerasHint: Video feeds of the vehicle in use and their camera control. They can be set up without a link to the vehicle; they are kept with the vehicle in the list.

OperatorRcBar.refused_no-joystick: No joystick is being read. Plug it in, click this window and press any button on the joystick.
OperatorRcBar.refused_not-centred: Let go of the stick first: control is taken with the stick at the centre.
OperatorRcBar.refused_needs-joystick: Reverse driving works with joystick control: switch the joystick on first.
OperatorRcBar.refused_moving: Stop first: reverse driving switches only at a standstill, with cruise off.
OperatorRcBar.sending: This channel is being sent to the vehicle
OperatorRcBar.joystickWakeTip: No joystick seen yet. Plug it in, click this window and press any button on it.
OperatorRcBar.joystickOffTip: Take control of steering and throttle with the joystick ({{name}}). The stick must be at the centre.
OperatorRcBar.joystickOnTip: The joystick ({{name}}) is driving. Press to hand steering and throttle back to the RC transmitter.
OperatorRcBar.joystickPausedTip: The joystick is not being read (no window of the program is in front, or it is unplugged), so the vehicle was stopped and let go. Click a window of the program and centre the stick to carry on.
OperatorRcBar.reverseTip: Reverse driving: the vehicle is driven tail-first exactly as it is driven nose-first. Switches only at a standstill.
OperatorRcBar.cruiseTip: Cruise control: holds the throttle. With the joystick it takes over the throttle held now; pulling the stick back or STOP switches it off.

OperatorRcSettings.learnTip: Click, then press the button (or move the stick) on the joystick
OperatorRcSettings.name: Name
OperatorRcSettings.channelConflict: Channel {{n}} is used by something else as well.
OperatorRcSettings.latchingHint: Press on, press off. Without it the button is on only while held.
OperatorRcSettings.springCenter: Returns to the middle when let go
OperatorRcSettings.springCenterHint: Without it the switch stays in the position it was put in.
OperatorRcSettings.sendOnConnect: Send from the moment of connection
OperatorRcSettings.sendOnConnectHint: Otherwise the channel is left alone until the operator first uses the control.
OperatorRcSettings.joystickHint: A USB joystick or gamepad drives steering and throttle over RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE. The operator takes control with the «Joystick» button every session, with the stick at the centre. If the joystick stops being read, the vehicle gets neutral and the channels go back to the RC transmitter.
OperatorRcSettings.noJoystick: No joystick seen. Plug it in and press any button on it.
OperatorRcSettings.driveEnabled: The operator may drive from the joystick
OperatorRcSettings.driveEnabledHint: Puts the «Joystick» button on the operator screen.
OperatorRcSettings.axisCheckHint: Check on the bars: stick to the right moves steering right (+), stick away from you moves throttle forward (+). If not, tick «reversed».
OperatorRcSettings.engageButton: Joystick button that takes and drops control:
OperatorRcSettings.conflicts: Channels used twice: {{list}}. Driving wins over a function on the same channel.
OperatorRcSettings.cruiseHint: Holds the throttle so the operator need not hold the stick. Pulling the stick back, STOP, disarming or a lost link switch it off. It holds the throttle position, not the speed over ground.
OperatorRcSettings.cruiseEnabled: Cruise button on the operator screen
OperatorRcSettings.reverseHint: A switch on the operator screen: the vehicle is driven tail-first as in normal driving - stick forward moves it backwards. Needs joystick driving; switches only at a standstill.
OperatorRcSettings.reverseEnabled: Reverse switch on the operator screen
OperatorRcSettings.invertSteeringHint: So that «right» on the stick is right in the rear camera. Switch off if the vehicle then turns the wrong way (depends on its PILOT_STEER_TYPE).
OperatorRcSettings.switchCamera: Put the rear camera on the main view while reversing
OperatorRcSettings.functionsHint: Your own controls on the operator screen, each sending one RC channel (RC_CHANNELS_OVERRIDE): a button, a three-position switch or a slider. They work from the screen and, when assigned, from the joystick. What a channel does is set on the flight controller (RCx_OPTION, servo functions).
OperatorRcSettings.servoHint: The output is set directly and held by the flight controller until changed. Only for outputs whose SERVOx_FUNCTION is 0 (Disabled).
OperatorRcSettings.startCenterHint: When the program starts the switch stands in the middle, so servos or a mechanism on the channel are not sent to an end position.
OperatorRcSettings.padTabPointer: Device choice, check and calibration are on the «Transmitter» tab.
OperatorRcSettings.invertThrottleHint: The stick pushed forward drives the vehicle tail-first. Switch off if reverse is done by its own channels below.
OperatorRcSettings.reverseChannelsHint: In reverse the sticks are used exactly as when driving forward; only what goes to the vehicle changes: the direction and, if set, the channels. The channels used when driving forward are let go while reverse is on.

OperatorPanelSettings.onlyManualRecording: shown only with recording «by the operator's button»
OperatorPanelSettings.cameraControlsOff: camera controls are switched off under «Screen»
OperatorPanelSettings.previewHint: The bottom bar as the operator will see it. Changes below show here at once.
OperatorPanelSettings.controlsHint: Everything on the operator's bottom bar, in order. The eye hides or shows an element, the arrows move it, the pencil opens its settings. Outputs, buttons, switches and sliders are added at the bottom. STOP, the mode list and ARM are always at the right end.
OperatorPanelSettings.iconsOnlyHint: For a panel with many controls: the names move into the tooltips.
OperatorPanelSettings.restoreTip: Put the deleted element back with all its settings

OperatorValuesSettings.hint: Values across the top of the operator screen, in this order. Besides the built-in ones, any value the vehicle has can be added: a field of any MAVLink message, a named value (NAMED_VALUE from a Lua script or a companion computer) or a flight controller parameter, with a unit, a scale and limits at which it turns amber and red.
OperatorValuesSettings.connectFirst: Connect to the vehicle to see what it sends.
OperatorValuesSettings.pickMessage: Pick a message on the left; click a field to add it.
OperatorValuesSettings.noNamed: The vehicle sends no named values right now.
OperatorValuesSettings.paramHint: Name as in the parameter list; read from the vehicle every 15 s.
OperatorValuesSettings.scaleHint: Source: {{source}}. Shown = value × scale + offset (e.g. millivolts to volts: × 0.001). Empty limits are not checked.

OperatorPadSettings.deviceHint: The USB device the station reads: an RC transmitter in joystick mode (EdgeTX / OpenTX: USB Joystick (HID)), a joystick or a gamepad. Headsets and keyboards are skipped.
OperatorPadSettings.notFoundHint: Plug the transmitter in over USB, choose «USB Joystick (HID)» on its screen, then move a stick or press a button: the system shows a device only after its first movement.
OperatorPadSettings.checkHint: Every axis and button of the device. The thin mark is the raw reading, the bar is the value after calibration. Green names show what the control is assigned to.
OperatorPadSettings.calibratedOther: This transmitter has not been set up yet (the saved set-up is for «{{name}}»).
OperatorPadSettings.notCalibrated: The sticks have not been shown yet: raw readings are used
OperatorPadSettings.stepCenter: Step 1 of 6. Let go of both sticks so they rest (a throttle stick without a spring: put it in the middle), then press «Next».
OperatorPadSettings.stepEnds: Move both sticks in full circles a few times, and every slider to both ends - the dots should reach the edges of the circles. Then press «Done». Steering goes to the right stick and throttle to the left one; this can be changed below.
OperatorPadSettings.assignHint: What each stick and button does. Click a control's button here, then move the stick or press the button on the transmitter.
OperatorPadSettings.sticksHint: The two circles are the sticks seen from above. The set-up asks you to push each stick once, so the program learns which is which and how far they travel; it is kept for this device and stays when the vehicle is changed.
OperatorPadSettings.newDevice: A new transmitter is connected. Show the program its sticks - it takes half a minute.
OperatorPadSettings.ask_lx: LEFT stick - push it RIGHT all the way
OperatorPadSettings.ask_ly: LEFT stick - push it UP (away from you) all the way
OperatorPadSettings.ask_rx: RIGHT stick - push it RIGHT all the way
OperatorPadSettings.ask_ry: RIGHT stick - push it UP (away from you) all the way
OperatorPadSettings.letGo: Got it. Now let the stick go back.

OperatorMessages.title: Messages
OperatorMessages.empty: No messages from the vehicle yet
OperatorMessages.show: Show all messages from the vehicle

OperatorInfoDock.unlock: Unlock to move the block or change its size
OperatorInfoDock.lock: Lock: the block stays where it is and as it is
